name: Jared Moskowitz

on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (FL) - District 25

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "2 years ago, the Supreme Court reversed Roe v. Wade, stripping Americans’ freedom to make their own health care decisions. These choices should be left to women and their doctors, not politicians. It’s time for Congress to codify Roe v. Wade into federal law."

"Never forget that Supreme Court judges lied to the U.S. Senate and the American people when they said Roe was settled law. 1 year after Dobbs, we must remember this egregious betrayal and act to ensure reproductive rights are protected across our nation."

"Today, on the 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade, let us be loud and clear that women in this country should have the legal right to make their own healthcare decisions without government dictating these highly personal matters."
Rated 100% by the Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "BREAKING: The House just passed my bipartisan Stop Harboring Iranian Petroleum (SHIP) Act. With this legislation, we’re one step closer to strengthening sanctions on Iran and holding the regime accountable for its funding of terrorism."

"Foreign adversaries will not get away with financing and facilitating terror. I’m proud to introduce legislation with @RepMikeLawler that will strengthen America’s sanctions on Iran and weaken the state’s ability to fund terrorist groups."

"The SHIP Act I introduced with @RepMikeLawler passed 342-69. These new sanctions on Iranian petroleum have broad bipartisan support. In light of new attacks on U.S. troops by Iran’s proxies, it’s critical that this is part of a whole of government approach against the regime."

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "It’s now one year since Putin’s deadly invasion of Ukraine. America’s global leadership is unwavering and we will continue to respond in a decisive way."
"Speaker Johnson is failing our allies. It’s way past time Congress pass aid for Israel and Ukraine that the majority of both parties support. We cannot let Putin or Hamas win."

"Today, the U.S. House showed the world and our allies that America can still lead. By delivering for Israel and Ukraine, we made it clear that we will not allow the extremists in the House to hand America’s allies over to Russia, Iran, and China."
Voted in favor of HR 8035 "Ukraine Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"
